prompt: What was the official retail price per liter (in VND, inclusive of VAT and environmental tax) of RON 92-III gasoline on April 24, 2025, according to PetroVietnam Oil Corporation (PVOIL)?
answer: According to PVOIL’s price list, **E5 RON 92-II gasoline**—there is no standard Vietnamese product designated “RON 92-III”—was **18,250 VND per liter**, inclusive of VAT and environmental tax, on April 24, 2025.
